name: Brodie Castle Adventure Playground and Playful Garden
description: A woodland adventure playground behind the castle, free for everyone, and the Playful Garden a short walk away, with Scotland's biggest rabbit sculpture, a mini castle to climb into, rabbit holes to crawl through and xylophones.
